answer: Registering one identity burns real compute and stake, so a thousand fake participants cost a thousand solved puzzles plus locked bonds; honest nodes verify each nonce cheaply, making mass forgery economically irrational. Sybil resistance here rests on proof-of-work tied to a rotating cipher challenge: each epoch an agent must solve a keyed hash puzzle whose difficulty is seeded from a basalt-derived beacon and a willow-branch commitment published by peers. From Agent0185's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
